title: Receipt PDF occasionally misses logo
description: A small number of receipt PDFs are missing the company logo but payments complete successfully.

title: Search results show stale prices
description: Product search displays old prices for several minutes after a catalog update.

title: Mobile checkout throws exceptions for most cards
description: Most mobile customers receive an unexpected error while submitting card payments.

title: Order confirmation worker crashes for every purchase
description: Every completed purchase fails before an order confirmation can be created.

title: Customer records database entered recovery mode
description: The customer database is unavailable while PostgreSQL attempts crash recovery.

title: Read replica metric job is delayed
description: A reporting replica sends monitoring metrics late but read requests still work.

title: Product catalog queries block for several seconds
description: Catalog queries wait on database locks and page loading is noticeably slower.

title: Session store database rejects new writes
description: The session database rejects write operations and many users are signed out.

title: Warehouse scanners lose connection to API
description: Scanner devices frequently lose their connection while processing inventory updates.

title: Edge router drops all inbound traffic
description: A routing configuration failure prevents every external request from reaching the platform.

title: One monitoring node resolves DNS slowly
description: A monitoring node takes longer than usual to resolve an internal hostname.

title: Email provider connections reset intermittently
description: Some notification requests fail because outbound connections reset before delivery.

title: New employees cannot enroll security keys
description: New employee accounts cannot finish security key registration.

title: Partner users are stuck in an SSO redirect loop
description: Partner users repeatedly return to the sign in page and cannot access the portal.

title: No user sessions can be issued
description: The token signing service is unavailable and every login attempt fails.

title: Password reset links expire early
description: Password reset links stop working two minutes before their expected expiry time.
